name: System File Checker (SFC)
description:
Scan and repair corrupted Windows system files using System File Checker.
- Run SFC in online mode on the current system.
- Run SFC in offline mode on another Windows installation.
- Specify offline boot drive and Windows directory.
- Scan only without attempting repairs.
